info.title: d365sec
info.description: Security model analysis for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Walks the role → sub-role → duty → privilege → entry-point chain plus direct grants and admin customizations, applying Deny-over-Grant (Deny wins). Answers effective permissions, object access, segregation-of-duties, licence assessment, and what-if role changes.

post.description: D365FO security analysis. Use this tool when the user asks about: which roles/duties/privileges a user has, who can (or is blocked from) access to an object/menu-item/button, effective permissions for a user or role (with Deny-over-Grant resolution and granted/partial/denied status), segregation-of-duties conflicts, licence cost of a role assignment, or the impact of adding/removing a role (what-if). Effective permissions distinguish hidden (no grant) from greyed (some operations denied) from enabled. Do NOT use for code metadata (use d365-kb / d365-xref).
